Allergy alert test kits are in the back cupboard, top shelf. If someone reacts in the chair, rinse with cool water, no shampoo, and write it in the incident book at the desk. Gail First aid reference for suspected chemical burns: NHS, Acid and chemical burns (https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/acid-and-chemical-burns/). Call 999 for medical help immediately; do not wait for blistering or severe pain. Protect yourself with gloves and carefully remove contaminated clothing if possible. Rinse the affected area with plenty of cool or lukewarm running water for about 1 hour. Do not apply creams or other chemicals. Chemical burns need hospital assessment. Breathing difficulty, throat swelling or collapse also require 999 immediately. Follow the call handler's instructions.
